helpers.name: Website smoke checker
helpers.description: Check HTTP status, final URL, response time and expected text in server HTML. JavaScript is not executed.
helpers.example_use: After a deployment, check your homepage, product page and checkout entry URL.

helpers.name: Log investigator
helpers.description: Group warning and error records from .NET/plain-text or JSON logs. Preserve multiline stack traces and normalize numeric IDs for grouping.
helpers.example_use: Find the most frequent exceptions in an IIS application log folder.

helpers.name: Tracking inspector
helpers.description: Inspect saved dataLayer events or capture a fresh Chromium session. Validate ecommerce fields and flag potential duplicate product views. Browser capture requires Playwright.
helpers.example_use: Leave Source file empty, enter a product URL, and interact with the browser during capture. Or inspect the included sample offline. This checks dataLayer, not GA4 delivery.

helpers.name: Product feed auditor
helpers.description: Validate JSON, CSV or XML product feeds for required IDs/names, duplicate IDs, prices, currency and image URL syntax. Map your feed fields below.
helpers.example_use: Audit an exported Google Merchant XML feed with xml_item=item, or a JSON API export with items_path=data.products.

helpers.name: Test data generator
helpers.description: Generate deterministic synthetic products, customers or orders. Order mode includes linked customer/product tables. Export the result as JSON.
helpers.example_use: Create 100 sample orders with valid customer/product references using a fixed seed for reproducibility.
helpers.code_example:
python cli.py test-data-generator --input examples/test-data-generator.json

# JSON inputs
{
  "kind": "orders",
  "count": 10,
  "seed": 42
}

helpers.name: API response comparer
helpers.description: Compare local JSON files or HTTP GET responses. Ignore fields, match object arrays by ID and apply an absolute numeric tolerance. Duplicate array IDs are reported as input errors.
helpers.example_use: Compare staging/production product responses while ignoring updatedAt and matching products by id. Headers are sent to both URLs; use only endpoints you trust.
helpers.code_example:
python cli.py api-comparer --input examples/api-comparer.json

# JSON inputs
{
  "left": "examples/api-left.json",
  "right": "examples/api-right.json",
  "array_key": "id",
  "ignore": [
    "updatedAt"
  ],
  "tolerance": 0
}

helpers.name: JSON validator
helpers.description: Validate JSON syntax with line/column diagnostics, duplicate-key checks and optional formatting. Accepts pasted content, HTTP(S) URLs or files. No JSON Schema validation.
helpers.example_use: Paste an API response and click Run helper. To fetch a document, select url mode and enter its HTTP(S) address. Only the selected input mode is read.

helpers.name: XML validator
helpers.description: Validate XML well-formedness with line/column diagnostics and element statistics. Accepts pasted content, HTTP(S) URLs or files. DTDs and XSD validation are not supported.
helpers.example_use: Paste an API response and click Run helper. To fetch a document, select url mode and enter its HTTP(S) address. Only the selected input mode is read.
